cardinalAudit.mainCatalog: Original atlas labels and actual native facings agree: S face, N back, E looks screen right, W screen left. Verified saved native stand images against original production atlas frame zero; different sampled pose frame5 only changes breathing.
cardinalAudit.runtimeVariants: Original runtime atlas labels and actual native facings agree with main catalog for Ellis. Verified eat-salmon and empty waiting against original Godot runtime atlases.

modelingFreedom: Native forms, proportions, construction, topology, materials and purposeful decoration may change. Original body mesh coordinates and part counts are evidence, not locks. Preserve rig/rest topology and functional attachment trajectories.

bodyEnvelopeProposal.basis: Per-sample animated native body bounds, excluding the camera-biased 2D food display quad. Do not apply standing anatomy height to seated/jumping poses.
bodyEnvelopeProposal.footprint: One world cell square at ground root. Source reaches abs X=.456761 and abs depth=.440728 in S across required poses; preserve occupied scale and functional clearances. Useful volume redesign may use the declared footprint without matching old weak surfaces.
bodyEnvelopeProposal.height: Use each source frame animated top as the functional clearance reference. Suggested quantitative ceiling source maximum Z +.01 world cell per sample; feet and seat support remain at measured contacts. This .01 tolerance is proposed for freeze, not an existing user lock.
bodyEnvelopeProposal.contacts: Exact rig rest matrices, native action data, root, food-root, yaw cancellation and contact socket paths; evaluate every sample. Rebuilt palms, soles, mouth and seated support must remain plausibly connected to those paths. Suggested measurement tolerance 1e-5 world cells for transforms and <=.005 world cells for remodeled support surfaces; freeze explicitly.

props.meal_variant: salmon eating; no food while waiting

depthPolicy: Actual source depth scalar .6 world cell along camera ray (0,-cos35,sin35), measured in all 576 samples. Permit one fixed scalar per food in [0,.6] only after global mapping; no per-frame/facing depth or projected support changes. Remapping changes nominal source quad corners because canonical rasters differ; require canonical mapped corners then remain fixed relative to attachment trajectory at every depth.
